note: SCR-01G (Keen 6): a game, from the title as the intro ends (Escape at 33 s: a key that cuts the intro short opens the panel at once in the user's v1.0, the title first in v1.4, J-19). NEW GAME, BEGIN NORMAL GAME: the level box and the world map (/NOCOPY: v1.0 never asks the creature question (its code is in KEEN6C.EXE but nothing calls it); v1.4, which the port plays, asks at a new game; v1.0 ignores the switch); Enter for the status window and a key to close it; Escape for the panel in a game, END GAME, its question, Y: the high scores. Menu keys 1.75 s apart (between two blinks of the cursor). Times are seconds after the EGA mode set (KEYFEED.COM types the keys in DOS).
